mods.name: Cavities Elin Face 7 Adornment 2
mods.author: cannibalism-princess
mods.short_description: Custom face decal for Elin, a fan design by cannibalism-princess.
mods.long_description:
A community face-decal design by cannibalism-princess, preserved from the mods-of-tera Tumblr archive. Ported to the v100 client as a TMM composite-slice payload: only the `Decal_popori_F_AG0001` decal slot is redirected, every other decal is untouched and the change is fully reversible. Decals for different face slots can be enabled together; two designs for the *same* slot are mutually exclusive.

The original post bundles two designs; this is the 'Cavities' design. Its sibling 'Glasgow' targets a different slot and can be enabled together.

Original post: https://mods-of-tera.tumblr.com/post/148940906002/cannibalism-princess-10-hours-on-mods-30
mods.credits: Original face-decal design by cannibalism-princess (https://mods-of-tera.tumblr.com/post/148940906002/cannibalism-princess-10-hours-on-mods-30). Rehosted for the TERA Europe Classic+ launcher; if you are the creator and want this reattributed or removed, open an issue on TERA-Europe-Classic/external-mod-catalog.
mods.tagline: Elin face decal at Face 7, Adornment 2.
mods.compatibility_notes: Ported offline (TMM composite-slice transplant); not yet verified in-game.

replaces_data.summary: Replaces the face decal at Elin character creation Face 7, Adornment 2.

mods.compatibility_notes: Catalog data quality issue: the URL points to S1UI_QuestTaskInfo.gpk but the file content is a ProgressBar/FlightGauge mod (only ProgressBar_I* exports). Mod target unclear. Adapted from DeathDefying's x32 mod by TERA-Europe-Classic for v100.02 (x64). May not look exactly as DeathDefying intended.
mods.broken: Interface window mod, re-listed after being pulled. The 64-bit client compiles each window into Flash symbols with generated texture names, while this payload names its art by hand; the two sets share no names, so a direct port is impossible. The working route is the one the block popups use: place the art into the compiled slot by appearance. Rebuild queued. UPDATE 2026-08-01: the "no name maps to v100" verdict was generalised from one window and is wrong for this family -- S1UI_CharacterWindow symbols like class21 and _I15D exist verbatim in v100. Each texture is being re-checked against the v100 symbol table, with pixel-matching for the ones that were renumbered.

replaces_data.summary: Removes the on-screen quest tracker (S1UI_QuestTaskInfo).

mods.name: Restyle: PaperDoll (x64 port)
mods.author: foglio1024
mods.short_description: Foglio's restyled character equipment window — x64 port for v100.02 client.
mods.long_description:
A modern restyled version of the character equipment / paperdoll window, originally by Foglio1024.

**This is an x64 port of foglio's x32-only mod.** Foglio's original `S1UI_PaperDoll.gpk` is file_version 610 (Classic x32) and cannot be byte-dropped onto v100.02 (x64). The TERA-Europe-Classic team extracted the modded SWF from foglio's `PaperDoll/p79/S1UI_PaperDoll79.gpk` and spliced it into a v100-native GFxMovieInfo wrapper, then re-emitted as a TMM-format composite GPK.

**May not look exactly as foglio intended.** Some texture object names were renumbered between Classic and v100, so a small subset of slot decorations may render differently than in foglio's screenshots. The core SWF (silhouettes adapt to v100 numeric race/sex coding, slot frame designs for filled and hover states) renders correctly.

**Empty equipment slots are intentionally invisible until hover** — foglio's documented minimalist design intent. See Risenio's "visible clears" community variant on foglio's wiki for the opposite preference.

The launcher automatically downloads and installs this mod for you. You can manage it from the mod manager.

**Alternatives -- other mods that replace the same thing**

- [Modern UI: Jewels Fix (PaperDoll)](mod:foglio1024.modern-ui-jewels-fix-paperdoll) by foglio1024 — currently being fixed
mods.credits: Originally by foglio1024 (https://github.com/foglio1024/tera-restyle). Adapted to v100.02 (x64) by the TERA-Europe-Classic team — modded SWF spliced into a v100-native wrapper. "Visible clears" alternative variant for always-visible empty slot frames is by Risenio per foglio's wiki. If you are the author and would prefer this entry removed, reattributed, or replaced with a different upstream URL, open an issue on TERA-Europe-Classic/external-mod-catalog.
mods.tagline: Foglio's PaperDoll restyle, x64-ported for v100.02. May differ slightly from foglio's.
mods.compatibility_notes: **Adapted for x64 from foglio's x32 mod — may not look exactly as intended.** Empty equipment slots are intentionally invisible until hover (foglio's design intent). Locked tier-2 perimeter slots use vanilla padlock graphics. Conflicts with `foglio1024.modern-ui-jewels-fix-paperdoll` and `taorelia.restyle-paperdoll` — pick one paperdoll restyle at a time. Now ships with proper TMM footer so the launcher can install via tmm::install_gpk.
mods.broken: Interface window mod, re-listed after being pulled. The 64-bit client compiles each window into Flash symbols with generated texture names, while this payload names its art by hand; the two sets share no names, so a direct port is impossible. The working route is the one the block popups use: place the art into the compiled slot by appearance. Rebuild queued. UPDATE 2026-08-01: the "no name maps to v100" verdict was generalised from one window and is wrong for this family -- S1UI_CharacterWindow symbols like class21 and _I15D exist verbatim in v100. Each texture is being re-checked against the v100 symbol table, with pixel-matching for the ones that were renumbered.

replaces_data.summary: Replaces the profile/equipment (P) window (S1UI_PaperDoll).

mods.name: Designer Shirt Red Details
mods.author: katmods
mods.short_description: Recolors details of the designer shirt red.
mods.long_description:
Recolour for the designer shirt :3 some details are coloured red.. completly black one and black/red will follow today evening :)

Original by katmods, shared on the mods-of-tera archive.
mods.credits: Shared on the mods-of-tera archive; original by katmods. Source: https://mods-of-tera.tumblr.com/post/179272785202/katmods-recolour-for-the-designer-shirt-3-some
mods.compatibility_notes: Re-routed off the dropin layer, which the 64-bit client never reads: it resolves costumes through CompositePackageMapper, not by filename. The art now goes into every composite package that embeds it.
mods.last_verified_patch: v100.02 (x32->x64 reconvert, pixel-verified; dropin; in-game render pending)

mods.short_description: Silver slit eyes, winged eyeliner and wine lips for Elin face 11.
mods.long_description:
Turns Elin face 11's purple eyes silver-white, swaps the lashes for bold winged eyeliner, removes the blush for a paler look, and tints the lips light wine.

The 2016 original was recovered from the author's still-working download after the first published file turned out to be a different mod entirely; only the face texture the author actually edited is carried over into this build.

**Alternatives -- other mods that replace the same thing**

- [Isis Eyes (Elin Face 1)](mod:kittieology.isis-eye-mod-by-after) by kittieology
- [Elin Face + Matching Ears & Tail](mod:mayukari.new-this-second-link-is-the-same-mod) by mayukari — currently being fixed
- [Dark Elin Face 9 Adornment 1](mod:moddymcmodface.dark-download-here-for) by moddymcmodface
- [Honey Elin Face 9 Adornment 1](mod:moddymcmodface.honey-download-here-for) by moddymcmodface

mods.name: Deep Teal Eyes Elin Face 11 Adornment 5
mods.author: nefristreo
mods.short_description: Custom face decal for Elin, a fan design by nefristreo.
mods.long_description:
A community face-decal design by nefristreo, preserved from the mods-of-tera Tumblr archive. Ported to the v100 client as a TMM composite-slice payload: only the `Decal_Popori_F_AK0004` decal slot is redirected, every other decal is untouched and the change is fully reversible. Decals for different face slots can be enabled together; two designs for the *same* slot are mutually exclusive.

Original post: https://mods-of-tera.tumblr.com/post/175274019022/nefristreo-a-simple-texture-mod-that-recolors

mods.broken:
ROUTE SOLVED 2026-08-01, and it needs no download at all. The Japanese audio is already in your client AND already addressable: the composite mapper carries a row per locale, so AIF_Viki_EUR.AIF_Viki_DialogStart and AIF_Viki_JPN.AIF_Viki_DialogStart are both live slices pointing into containers on disk. Coverage is exact -- across five sampled banks every one of 58 base sounds and all 58 EUR sounds has a matching JPN row, 1:1.

So the mod is a MAPPER REROUTE: repoint the row the client reads at the JPN row's file, offset and length. No payload, no 89 MB download, and no redistribution of the publisher's audio -- which the earlier plan of shipping copies of <Bank>_JPN.gpk would have meant. It also sidesteps the size check that killed the original build, because no file is written.

What it needs: a launcher deploy strategy that rewrites mapper rows and restores them on uninstall. Nothing in the catalog uses one yet; every current strategy ships a file. That is the one piece of work left, and it is launcher-side.

Note the client reads by locale (S1Engine.ini Language=INT) and both base and EUR variants exist, so the reroute should cover both to be safe -- 122 base and 120 EUR banks.

mods.name: Elin Strawberry Maid
mods.author: pantypon
mods.short_description: Elin strawberry maid recolor of PC Event 53.
mods.long_description:
Elin strawberry maid recolor of the chambermaid dress. Ships as a TERA Mod Manager package; the launcher installs and reverses it through the composite mapper. Sourced from the author's own repository, credited below.

**Alternatives -- other mods that replace the same thing**

- [Peaches and Jeans](mod:taylorswiftmodding.peaches-and-jeans) by TheTaylorSwiftOfModding
mods.credits: Published by pantypon at https://github.com/pantypon/tera-client-mods. If you are the author and would prefer this entry removed or reattributed, open an issue on TERA-Europe-Classic/external-mod-catalog.
mods.tagline: A new look for Chambermaid's Dress.
mods.last_verified_patch: v100.02 (dropin, smoke-verified)
mods.compatibility_notes: Rebuilt from pantypon's own release. The previous build was an ~8 KB specular map with no deploy strategy and did nothing; this ships every texture the author made, for every race and colour variant the costume has.
mods.replaces: Chambermaid's Dress (Human Female) (#254300); Dyeable Chambermaid's Dress (Human Female) (#254312); Chambermaid's Dress (High Elf Female) (#254324); Dyeable Chambermaid's Dress (High Elf Female) (#254336); Chambermaid's Dress (Amani Female) (#254348); Dyeable Chambermaid's Dress (Amani Female) (#254360); Chambermaid's Dress (Castanic Female) (#254372); Dyeable Chambermaid's Dress (Castanic Female) (#254384); Chambermaid's Dress (Elin) (#254396); Dyeable Chambermaid's Dress (Elin) (#254408)

replaces_data.summary: Ships a full replacement of this costume set, so any of these can be affected.

The 64-bit client compiles each window into Flash symbols with generated texture names, while this payload names its art by hand; the two sets share no names, so a direct port is impossible. The working route is the one the block popups use: place the art into the compiled slot by appearance. Rebuild queued. UPDATE 2026-08-01: the "no name maps to v100" verdict was generalised from one window and is wrong for this family -- S1UI_CharacterWindow symbols like class21 and _I15D exist verbatim in v100. Each texture is being re-checked against the v100 symbol table, with pixel-matching for the ones that were renumbered.

mods.broken: Root cause found 2026-08-01, twice over. First: the payload this entry shipped was our own foglio-x64-port build, and that port emitted vanilla -- every texture AND the compiled movie matched the client byte for byte, so nothing could ever render. The author's real file is now recovered from https://github.com/Taorelia/tera-restyle. These are changes
softer colours
sliver details

mods.name: Steel Wings to Demon Wings
mods.author: purpleelf
mods.short_description: Swaps the steel-tipped demon wings accessory for plain demon wings.
mods.long_description:
Swaps the steel-tipped demon wings accessory for plain demon wings. A model swap: the author's whole package, converted from the 32-bit client format to the 64-bit one, replaces the loose package the engine reads first. The launcher verifies the vanilla file before replacing it and restores it byte-perfect on uninstall.

Rebuilt with the mesh's materials rebound to this package -- a SkeletalMesh stores its material list as indices into its own object table, so a straight copy bound the wrong one. The 5 variant textures are imported inline, which severs the texture-cache link so the engine reads them from the package.

Swaps the Reaper's animation set with the Ninja's on Elin -- and the Ninja's with the Reaper's. It is a two-way trade, not a one-way replacement: play a Reaper and you get Ninja stance, jump, run and idle; play a Ninja and you get the Reaper's.

That is the author's design, not a side effect. All ten set-pairs in their payload are mutual, and it is how this class of animation swap has always worked.

Built entirely from the client's own animation data -- every one of the 66 sequences it moves is a stock animation the game already ships -- across 10 slices covering body, face, hair and tail.

Original animation swap by katmods.
mods.credits: Original animation mod by katmods (tumblr), archived from the community Discord (channel "Анимации", shared by Sonael). If you are the author and want this removed or reattributed, open an issue on TERA-Europe-Classic/external-mod-catalog. Cover is the author's own screenshot from their animation-mods post (mods-of-tera, post 180441167717), which announces these swaps together.

mods.name: Air-Swim (In Place)
mods.author: alqmia (Kin)
mods.short_description: Walking becomes the swim-in-place animation, on land (Elin).
mods.long_description:
Walk on land and your character treads water instead. The walking animation is replaced with the game's own swim-in-place loop, across body, face, hair and tail.

Rebuilt from the client's own data. The archived payload carries none of this mod's content -- its sequences are byte-identical to the Air-Swim (Forward) payload -- so the effect is reconstructed from stock animations the client already ships.

TO SEE IT YOU MUST WALK, not run. TERA runs by default, so toggle walk mode; running uses a different animation and is untouched.

This is a reconstruction of alqmia (Kin)'s mod, not their original file.

**Alternatives -- other mods that replace the same thing**

- [Mount-Flight Walk](mod:alqmia.fly-walk) by alqmia (Kin)

The archived payload carried none of this mod's content, so the effect is reconstructed from the client's own animations; the concept is alqmia (Kin)'s.

Six of the eleven now build: mesh transplanted, 2 materials added, nothing lost and nothing duplicated against vanilla. What is still missing is the ART: these payloads carry textures under names the vanilla slice does not have (WitchApprentice_diff and friends), so there is no slot to import them over and the copy pass does not reach them -- a material's texture parameters are not plain ObjectProperties. Built as-is the minion would show the new mesh with vanilla textures, so it is not shipped. Needs the payload's Texture2D objects copied in as new exports. Five others still do not resolve a Skel row and need their object names checked case by case.

mods.compatibility_notes: CLASS CANARY with prior evidence AGAINST it: a loose S1UI file was tested in game on 2026-07-25 and did not change rendering. That test predates the x32-to-x64 package transform this build went through, so the question is whether the transformed movie gets loaded where the untransformed one was ignored. Either verdict is informative: renders = about thirty interface mods follow this route; vanilla = the class needs the pixel-swap route the block popups proved. Uninstall restores vanilla byte-perfect.

mods.author: TERA Europe Classic
mods.credits: Built by the TERA Europe Classic catalog tooling. Contains no third-party content.
mods.short_description: A diagnostic that changes nothing in game, to test the animation deploy route.
mods.replaces: Nothing. Every animation byte is identical to vanilla.

replaces_data.summary: Nothing. Every animation byte is identical to vanilla.
loose: 12 Elin emote animation slices, rewritten with identical content

mods.long_description:
A test file, not a cosmetic mod. Install it, launch, and see whether you reach the character screen.

It carries the same twelve Elin emote slices a dance mod ships, rewritten and redirected through the identical route, with every animation byte left exactly as the client shipped it. Nothing looks different in game.

That makes it a clean answer to one question: can the client load a redirected animation slice at all? A crash blames the route. A clean boot blames the data the earlier build carried, and clears the way for the animation mods.

Uninstall from the launcher when you are done -- it restores the vanilla files.
